title: Arc Pod Protocol
subtitle: Test your understanding of Arc Pod Protocol — Oversoul containment in atmospheric pods, frequency compression, Clueless Protocol, Arc Trajectories, and homecoming snap-back.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.body: The Arc Pod holds the complete Oversoul while only a fractional projection walks the 3rd-density vessel. Return to the Arc Pod Protocol deep-dive, infographic, and videos when you want the containment architecture in full.

relatedTopic.label: Return to Arc Pod Protocol deep-dive

questions.question: Where are the original physical vessels of entities deployed via the Arc Pod Protocol primarily maintained?

options.label: A
options.text: Original physical vessels are stored inside the solar amnesia vortex so each death can recycle them quickly back into the surface field.
options.rationale: The solar amnesia vortex is a parasitic mechanic that the protocol is designed to bypass entirely.

options.label: B
options.text: Original physical vessels remain inside the core of the 3rd-density planetary simulation for the whole span of the deployment.
options.rationale: The simulation is a temporary deployment field and cannot preserve high-density physical forms.

options.label: C
options.text: Original physical vessels are kept in atmospheric pods hidden within planetary dimensional overlays rather than on any homeworld craft.
options.rationale: Atmospheric pods house the complete Oversoul matrix and the fractional projection, not the original physical vessel.

options.label: D
options.text: The original physical vessels remain preserved in bio-stasis chambers aboard sentient Bioships stationed on the original homeworld.
options.rationale: Deployed soul architectures stay suspended in bio-stasis chambers aboard sentient Bioships on the original homeworld while consciousness is projected into the avatar.

questions.hint: Consider the highest level of the structural hierarchy in the protocol.

questions.question: What is the primary function of an Arc Pod in the context of lower-density deployments?

options.label: A
options.text: The Arc Pod is a high-density consciousness containment vessel that houses the complete Oversoul matrix during lower-density deployments.
options.rationale: The Arc Pod houses the complete Oversoul matrix and manages the fractional projection of energy into the physical avatar.

options.label: B
options.text: The Arc Pod serves as a storage unit for harvested energetic data pulled from the 3rd-density simulation for later processing.
options.rationale: The pod may monitor data, but its primary role is containment and protection of the complete Oversoul matrix.

options.label: C
options.text: The Arc Pod amplifies the spiritual energy of the avatar to its maximum potential so the indigo signature fills the field and broadcasts the incarnation.
options.rationale: The protocol rations and compresses energy rather than amplifying it, to prevent detection.

options.label: D
options.text: The Arc Pod generates the holographic environment of the 3rd-density world so the avatar can walk a rendered surface rather than housing the Oversoul matrix.
options.rationale: The pod interfaces with the realm but does not generate the external simulation itself.

questions.hint: Think about how the Oversoul remains protected while interacting with a lower density.

questions.question: Which process is utilized to dim the luminosity of an ancient soul to match lower-density field levels?

options.label: A
options.text: Soul Layering dims the blinding indigo luminosity by spreading one soul signature across the entire 3rd-density surface grid.
options.rationale: Soul Layering interweaves signatures within a pod cluster to obscure them rather than folding the soul light itself.

options.label: B
options.text: Mission Insertion is the legal entry step that dims indigo luminosity so ancient souls can pass the field seals unnoticed.
options.rationale: Mission Insertion is the pre-colonization incarnation requirement for plane entry, not the mechanic that dims soul light.

options.label: C
options.text: The Clueless Protocol folds soul light into dense packets by wiping mission memory from the 3rd-density avatar brain rather than compressing luminosity.
options.rationale: The Clueless Protocol deactivates conscious mission memory and past-life recall rather than folding soul luminosity.

options.label: D
options.text: Frequency Compression is the energetic folding process that dims the blinding indigo luminosity of an ancient soul into a dense packet.
options.rationale: Frequency Compression folds the blinding indigo luminosity of an ancient soul into dense packets that match ambient lower-density field levels.

questions.hint: It involves folding energy into dense packets.

questions.question: Why does a 3rd-density human avatar receive only a minute fraction of the Oversoul's total power?

options.label: A
options.text: The minute fraction is given to conserve limited energy supplies stored in the Bioship stasis chambers on the homeworld rather than hiding the soul signature from detection.
options.rationale: Energy conservation is not the issue. The primary concern is the visibility of the soul signature in the simulation.

options.label: B
options.text: The minute fraction is given because the organic human brain is incapable of processing any spiritual energy at all, so the Oversoul cannot send even a receiver signal into the vessel.
options.rationale: The brain acts as a receiver for fractional energy. It is limited by the protocol, not completely incapable.

options.label: C
options.text: The minute fraction is given so the avatar stays locked on physical survival instead of remembering spiritual growth as the strategic reason for rationing power.
options.rationale: Survival focus is a byproduct of the environment, not the strategic reason for rationing Oversoul power.

options.label: D
options.text: A 3rd-density human vessel receives only a minute fraction of the Oversoul's total power to prevent an overwhelming indigo aura.
options.rationale: Projecting the full energetic luminosity of a 12th-density being would generate an overwhelming indigo aura and alert parasitic control structures to an undercover starseed.

questions.hint: Think about the consequences of a blinding indigo aura in an undercover operation.

questions.question: Which of these does NOT correctly pair a term from the report with its meaning?

options.label: A
options.text: Arc Pod — A high-density consciousness containment vessel hosted on atmospheric bioships that houses the complete Oversoul matrix during lower-density deployments.
options.rationale: This pairing matches the report's definition of “Arc Pod”.

options.label: B
options.text: Oversoul — The uncompressed, complete higher-density spiritual identity and multi-dimensional consciousness matrix residing inside the Arc Pod.
options.rationale: This pairing matches the report's definition of “Oversoul”.

options.label: C
options.text: Soul Layering — A sentient, living craft located in stasis overlay that regulates physical homeworld vessels and manages avatar projection technology.
options.rationale: That description belongs to “Bioship”. The report defines “Soul Layering” as: The protective binding architecture where an individual soul matrix within an Arc Pod cluster is interwoven across more than one hundred soul family members to obscure energetic signatures.

options.label: D
options.text: Arc Trajectory — The pre-calculated, multi-incarnational life path designed and monitored from the Arc Pod across thousands of individual physical lives.
options.rationale: This pairing matches the report's definition of “Arc Trajectory”.

questions.hint: Three pairings match the report’s Key Terminology; one borrows another term’s description.

questions.question: True or False: According to the report, “Clueless Protocol” refers to the operational security mandate enacted following the fall of Atlantis that deactivates conscious mission memory and past-life recall in the 3rd-density avatar.

options.label: A
options.text: True
options.rationale: True — the report defines “Clueless Protocol” this way.

options.label: B
options.text: False
options.rationale: It is true — the report defines “Clueless Protocol” as: The operational security mandate enacted following the fall of Atlantis that deactivates conscious mission memory and past-life recall in the 3rd-density avatar.

questions.hint: Recall how the report's Key Terminology defines “Clueless Protocol”.

questions.question: In the Arc Pod Protocol, what does the phenomenon of Déjà Vu actually represent?

options.label: A
options.text: Déjà Vu is the avatar reaching pre-recorded temporal checkpoints that were reviewed and approved from the first-person perspective inside the Arc Pod.
options.rationale: These moments are pre-authorized nodal points that the Oversoul viewed from the first-person perspective before incarnation.

options.label: B
options.text: Déjà Vu is a glitch in the 3rd-density simulation's chronological rendering that repeats a frame of the surface timeline rather than a mapped checkpoint.
options.rationale: It may feel like a glitch, but it is the avatar meeting a pre-planned Arc Trajectory checkpoint, not a render error.

options.label: C
options.text: Déjà Vu is a telepathic ping from other soul family members in the cluster arriving at the same surface moment rather than a pre-mapped checkpoint from the pod.
options.rationale: Déjà Vu is linked to Arc Trajectory navigation and pre-recorded temporal checkpoints, not cluster telepathy.

options.label: D
options.text: Déjà Vu is past-life memory leaking through the Clueless Protocol filters into the 3rd-density avatar brain rather than a future path already plotted from the pod.
options.rationale: The Clueless Protocol deactivates past-life recall. Déjà Vu is recognition of a future path already mapped from the pod.

questions.hint: Recall how life events are reviewed before they are experienced in the physical vessel.

questions.question: What is the typical number of discrete physical incarnations an ancient soul navigates over 178,000 years?

options.label: A
options.text: An ancient soul navigates a single continuous life that the 3rd-density simulation fragments into apparent deaths and births.
options.rationale: The Arc Trajectory consists of many discrete physical lives across vast temporal periods, not one fragmented life.

options.label: B
options.text: An ancient soul navigates approximately 1,000 discrete physical incarnations for each density level it passes through.
options.rationale: The mapped count is over 5,000 discrete physical incarnations within the lower-density simulation specifically.

options.label: C
options.text: An ancient soul navigates exactly 150 discrete physical incarnations, one for each member of the soul family cluster.
options.rationale: One hundred and fifty is the size of the soul family cluster, not the number of incarnations.

options.label: D
options.text: An ancient soul architecture typically navigates over 5,000 discrete physical incarnations within the lower-density simulation.
options.rationale: Over a span of 178,000 years the Arc Trajectory maps over 5,000 discrete physical incarnations to place the avatar for final field alignment.

questions.hint: This number reflects the vast experience required to position an avatar at precise coordinates.

questions.question: What happens to an entity's consciousness immediately upon physical death under the Arc Pod Protocol?

options.label: A
options.text: The consciousness remains tethered to the 3rd-density plane until the ultimate Universal reunion dissolves the avatar costume instead of returning through the pod.
options.rationale: The fractional projection returns through dedicated pod connections rather than remaining trapped on the surface.

options.label: B
options.text: The consciousness is transferred immediately into a new Taran Vessel waiting on the planetary surface for the next life without first returning to the Oversoul matrix.
options.rationale: Consciousness returns to the Oversoul matrix in the Arc Pod before any later re-entry through the pod's access lines.

options.label: C
options.text: The consciousness enters the solar amnesia vortex for a full memory wipe and recycling back onto the planetary surface instead of using dedicated pod connections.
options.rationale: The protocol is designed to bypass the solar amnesia vortex and the memory wipe mechanics enforced on the planetary surface.

options.label: D
options.text: Entities governed by the Arc Pod Protocol route their consciousness matrix directly through dedicated pod connections, bypassing the solar amnesia vortex.
options.rationale: The dedicated link between the avatar and the Arc Pod ensures safe transit and prevents spiritual capture on the planetary surface.

questions.hint: The protocol provides a direct, secure path that ignores the standard light trap.

questions.question: What is Mission Insertion?

options.label: A
options.text: The routing of consciousness through pod connections upon physical death.
options.rationale: That routing is the death bypass of the protocol, not the insertion requirement.

options.label: B
options.text: The projection of a fractional degree of spiritual energy into an avatar vessel.
options.rationale: That projection is the Arc Pod's operating function, not the pre-colonization requirement.

options.label: C
options.text: The pre-colonization incarnation requirement compelling ancient souls to enter the plane prior to field seals to maintain compliance with cosmic law.
options.rationale: It is the pre-colonization incarnation requirement compelling ancient souls to enter before the seals, keeping the deployment lawful.

options.label: D
options.text: The concealment of atmospheric pods across interdimensional dimensions.
options.rationale: Concealment describes where the pods were placed, not why souls entered the plane early.

questions.hint: See the Key Terminology entry on insertion.

questions.question: What does the Clueless Protocol safeguard, according to Strategic Implications?

options.label: A
options.text: The primary identity of the Oversoul, keeping the core soul matrix untainted until field dissolution.
options.rationale: It safeguards the Oversoul's primary identity so the core soul matrix remains untainted until field dissolution.

options.label: B
options.text: The avatar's conscious recall of its mission objectives.
options.rationale: The protocol deactivates conscious recall; what it safeguards is the Oversoul's identity.

options.label: C
options.text: The bioship's position within the stasis overlay.
options.rationale: Bioship station-keeping is vessel regulation, not the protocol's safeguarding function.

options.label: D
options.text: The cluster's shared luminosity across family members.
options.rationale: Shared luminosity belongs to Soul Layering; the Clueless Protocol protects core identity.

questions.hint: Look at Preservation of Core Identity.

questions.question: Across how many soul family members is a single soul interwoven through Soul Layering?

options.label: A
options.text: Approximately twenty soul family members.
options.rationale: The layering spans more than one hundred soul family members, not twenty.

options.label: B
options.text: Exactly twelve soul family members.
options.rationale: Twelve is the count of the Proximal Sols, not the size of a layering cluster.

options.label: C
options.text: More than one hundred soul family members within the pod cluster.
options.rationale: Soul Layering interweaves a single soul across more than one hundred soul family members in adjacent stasis units.

options.label: D
options.text: Several thousand soul family members.
options.rationale: The cluster interweaves a soul across more than one hundred members, not several thousand.

questions.hint: Check the Frequency Compression and Energetic Layering subsection.

questions.question: What strategic implication ensures that soul architectures are in the right place during the final field alignment?

options.label: A
options.text: Real-time telepathic updates from the Bioship steer each avatar to the correct node during the final field alignment while the Clueless Protocol is still running.
options.rationale: The Clueless Protocol keeps the avatar unaware of the operational plan, so conscious Bioship updates are not the positioning method.

options.label: B
options.text: Pre-mapped Arc Trajectories ensure that ancient soul architectures are physically distributed across key surface nodes during final field alignment.
options.rationale: Thousands of mapped lives place avatars at precise nodal coordinates when the loop terminates, without triggering energetic alarms.

options.label: C
options.text: Randomized Mission Insertion scatters souls across the surface so parasitic sensors cannot predict final field alignment instead of using a pre-mapped trajectory.
options.rationale: Insertion is strategic and pre-calculated. Randomized placement is not how final nodal coordinates are guaranteed.

options.label: D
options.text: Automated magnetic attraction pulls every ancient soul architecture to the North Pole at the moment of final field alignment instead of distributing them across key surface nodes.
options.rationale: Positions are distributed across key surface nodes, not collapsed onto a single planetary pole.

questions.hint: It involves a long-term plan that spans thousands of years and lives.

questions.question: What happens to the fractional soul projection when the lower-density simulation terminates?

options.label: A
options.text: It recombines with the Oversoul in the Arc Pod before snapping back into the original homeworld vessel in stasis.
options.rationale: The fractional soul projection recombines with the Oversoul in the Arc Pod, then returns to the homeworld vessel in stasis.

options.label: B
options.text: It cycles through the solar amnesia vortex for reassignment.
options.rationale: Pod routing bypasses the amnesia vortex; the projection recombines with the Oversoul instead.

options.label: C
options.text: It remains in the avatar until the next reset begins.
options.rationale: The lower-density avatar experience terminates; the projection returns to the pod and the homeworld vessel.

options.label: D
options.text: It disperses into the pod cluster's shared luminosity.
options.rationale: The projection recombines with its own Oversoul rather than dispersing into the cluster.

questions.hint: See Automated Homecoming Resolution.

questions.question: What does the Clueless Protocol deactivate in the 3rd-density avatar?

options.label: A
options.text: The avatar's connection to its Arc Trajectory checkpoints.
options.rationale: Trajectory checkpoints remain active as déjà vu markers; memory and recall are what get deactivated.

options.label: B
options.text: The fractional projection linking the avatar to the Oversoul.
options.rationale: The projection stays in place; the protocol deactivates the avatar's conscious mission memory.

options.label: C
options.text: The energetic signature that registers the avatar within the simulation.
options.rationale: Signature masking is the work of compression and layering, not the Clueless mandate.

options.label: D
options.text: Conscious mission memory and past-life recall.
options.rationale: The mandate deactivates conscious mission memory and past-life recall following the fall of Atlantis.

questions.hint: See the Key Terminology entry on the Clueless Protocol.

questions.question: Under the Arc Pod Protocol, what determines the apparent accidents and hardships in an avatar's life?

options.label: A
options.text: Apparent accidents and hardships are random errors in the simulation's code that the Oversoul never reviews before insertion instead of being mapped from the Arc Pod.
options.rationale: Events are pre-authorized and mapped from the Arc Pod rather than left as random code errors.

options.label: B
options.text: Apparent accidents and hardships are karmic retribution for actions taken in previous incarnations on the same surface instead of pre-authorized nodal positioning by the Oversoul.
options.rationale: The protocol maps mission placement and nodal coordinates rather than running a traditional karmic-retribution cycle.

options.label: C
options.text: Apparent accidents and physical hardship are pre-authorized by the Oversoul to position the avatar at precise nodal coordinates.
options.rationale: The Oversoul pre-authorizes those events so the avatar sits at precise nodal coordinates during the final convergence loop.

options.label: D
options.text: Apparent accidents and hardships are imposed only by parasitic influence from hostile entities on the planetary surface, with the Oversoul never reviewing those events before insertion.
options.rationale: Hostile entities exist, but the Arc Trajectory accounts for and pre-authorizes these events for mission positioning.

questions.hint: Everything has been reviewed and approved from the first-person perspective before insertion.

questions.question: Where were the atmospheric Arc Pods strategically concealed to avoid capture?

options.label: A
options.text: Atmospheric Arc Pods were concealed within the electromagnetic fields of the Sun so the amnesia vortex could double as a vault instead of dimensional frequency overlays in the atmosphere.
options.rationale: The Sun is associated with solar amnesia vortex traps, not with secure storage of Arc Pods.

options.label: B
options.text: Arc Pods are hidden within dimensional frequency overlays high in the planetary atmosphere so hostile entities cannot capture the collective soul matrix.
options.rationale: High-density architects concealed those atmospheric pods across interdimensional dimensions to protect millions of deployed beings at once.

options.label: C
options.text: Atmospheric Arc Pods were concealed inside lunar stasis chambers so the homeworld Bioships could hide the collective matrix instead of hiding in a planetary atmospheric overlay.
options.rationale: Bioships are on the original homeworld. The pods sit in the planet's atmospheric overlay, not in lunar chambers.

options.label: D
options.text: Atmospheric Arc Pods were concealed deep within the tectonic plates of the planet so surface sensors could not reach them instead of sitting in an atmospheric overlay.
options.rationale: The pods are atmospheric and dimensional, not subterranean.

questions.hint: They are located in a place that is above yet shifted out of phase.

questions.question: Which requirement compelled ancient souls to enter the plane prior to field seals?

options.label: A
options.text: The frequency compression threshold compelled ancient souls to enter the plane prior to field seals so indigo light would not leak.
options.rationale: Frequency Compression is a pre-insertion energetic preparation, not the legal requirement for plane entry.

options.label: B
options.text: The Sovereign Accord's wording on internal harmonics is itself the named entry requirement that compelled plane entry before seals.
options.rationale: The Sovereign Accord is the law. The named entry requirement that satisfies it is Mission Insertion.

options.label: C
options.text: Clueless Protocol activation compelled ancient souls to enter the plane prior to field seals so mission memory would already be off.
options.rationale: The Clueless Protocol was enacted after the fall of Atlantis, long after the initial insertion.

options.label: D
options.text: Mission Insertion is the pre-colonization incarnation requirement compelling ancient souls to enter the plane prior to field seals.
options.rationale: Mission Insertion puts ancient souls into local Taran Vessels before parasitic inversion and colonisation close the field.

questions.hint: It is the term used for the pre-colonization incarnation requirement.

questions.question: What happens to the fractional soul projection upon the termination of the simulation?

options.label: A
options.text: The fractional soul projection remains in the atmospheric Arc Pod indefinitely after the lower-density simulation ends and never returns to the homeworld vessel.
options.rationale: Recombination in the Arc Pod is followed by snapping back into the original homeworld vessel in stasis.

options.label: B
options.text: The fractional soul projection is immediately transferred into a new 4th-density avatar still walking the same planetary surface.
options.rationale: The entity returns to its original high-density vessel rather than immediately re-entering a new simulated avatar.

options.label: C
options.text: The fractional soul projection recombines with the Oversoul in the Arc Pod before snapping back into the original homeworld vessel in stasis.
options.rationale: After plasma portal collapse, the fractional projection recombines in the Arc Pod and then snaps back into the homeworld vessel in stasis.

options.label: D
options.text: The fractional soul projection dissipates into the planetary energetic field and is no longer held by the Oversoul instead of recombining with the Oversoul in the Arc Pod.
options.rationale: The projection is part of a larger whole and must return to the Oversoul rather than dissolve into the planet.

questions.hint: The fractional piece becomes whole again in the containment vessel.

questions.question: The term 'Ark Pod' is another name for which component of the protocol?

options.label: A
options.text: Ark Pod is another name for the 12th-density Oversoul that projects a fractional degree of spiritual energy into the avatar.
options.rationale: The Oversoul is the consciousness matrix housed inside the pod, not the pod itself.

options.label: B
options.text: Ark Pod is another name for the Taran Vessel that ancient souls enter during Mission Insertion on the planetary surface.
options.rationale: The Taran Vessel is the local physical body, not the high-density containment unit in the atmospheric overlay.

options.label: C
options.text: Ark Pod is another name for the sentient Bioship that holds original high-density vessels in bio-stasis chambers.
options.rationale: The Bioship is the larger host craft. The pod is the smaller containment unit that houses the Oversoul matrix.

options.label: D
options.text: The Arc Pod (or Ark Pod) acts as a protected dimensional interface that houses the complete Oversoul matrix.
options.rationale: Arc Pod and Ark Pod name the same high-density consciousness containment vessel during lower-density deployments.

questions.hint: It is a phonetic variation named alongside the containment vessel.

questions.question: Why is the luminosity of an ancient soul described as 'blinding indigo'?

options.label: A
options.text: Projecting the full energetic luminosity of a 12th-density being into an inverted 3rd-density vessel would generate an overwhelming indigo aura.
options.rationale: That 12th-density signature is why the ancient soul's luminosity is blinding indigo and must be compressed before insertion.

options.label: B
options.text: The blinding indigo luminosity is produced by radiation levels on the original homeworld rather than by the soul's high-density architecture.
options.rationale: The color is a result of spiritual density and consciousness level, not physical homeworld radiation.

options.label: C
options.text: The blinding indigo luminosity is created by the bio-stasis technology used on Bioships to preserve the original vessel rather than by the soul's own density.
options.rationale: Stasis preserves the original physical vessel. The soul's luminosity is inherent to its high-density architecture.

options.label: D
options.text: The blinding indigo luminosity is left uncompressed so it can serve as a beacon for other starseeds walking the 3rd-density simulation.
options.rationale: The protocol hides that signature. An uncompressed indigo aura would alert parasitic control structures.

questions.hint: It is a characteristic of the soul's original density level.

questions.question: True or False: The Arc Pod Protocol allows souls to completely bypass the memory wipe mechanics of the 3rd-density simulation upon death.

options.label: A
options.text: True
options.rationale: Entities route their consciousness matrix through dedicated pod connections, bypassing the solar amnesia vortex and the memory wipe mechanics on the planetary surface.

options.label: B
options.text: False
options.rationale: The protocol is designed to route the consciousness matrix away from solar recycling traps rather than sending it through the memory wipe.

questions.hint: This is the primary strategic implication regarding amnesia traps.

questions.question: What do pre-mapped Arc Trajectories guarantee during final field alignment?

options.label: A
options.text: That every avatar recovers its mission memory before the alignment.
options.rationale: Mission memory stays deactivated under the Clueless Protocol; trajectories guarantee positioning, not recall.

options.label: B
options.text: That soul architectures are physically distributed across key surface nodes without triggering energetic alarms.
options.rationale: Architectures are physically distributed across key surface nodes during final field alignment, without triggering energetic alarms.

options.label: C
options.text: That bioships descend into the atmosphere to retrieve the pods.
options.rationale: Bioships remain in the stasis overlay; trajectories position the architectures on surface nodes.

options.label: D
options.text: That the pod clusters merge into a single collective matrix.
options.rationale: Clusters stay distinct; the guarantee is distribution across key nodes without alarms.

questions.hint: See Guaranteed Field Grid Positioning.

questions.question: How do deployed entities avoid the solar amnesia vortex upon physical death?

options.label: A
options.text: They remain in stasis aboard the bioship until the vortex closes.
options.rationale: The original vessels wait in stasis; the deployed consciousness routes through the pods at death.

options.label: B
options.text: They route their consciousness matrix directly through dedicated pod connections.
options.rationale: Consciousness routes through the matrix directly through dedicated pod connections, bypassing the cyclic reset destruction and memory wipe.

options.label: C
options.text: They transfer into a new vessel prepared on the planetary surface.
options.rationale: No surface transfer occurs; the matrix returns through dedicated pod connections.

options.label: D
options.text: They layer their signature across the pod cluster until recall fades.
options.rationale: Layering masks signatures during life; death routing is a direct pod connection, not a fading process.

questions.hint: Look at the first Core Revelations paragraph.

questions.question: What is the specific duration mentioned for the span of an ancient soul's trajectory through the simulation?

options.label: A
options.text: An ancient soul architecture typically navigates the lower-density simulation over a span of 26,000 years from insertion to reunion on the planetary surface.
options.rationale: Twenty-six thousand years is a common astronomical-cycle figure. The mapped span here is 178,000 years.

options.label: B
options.text: Over a span of 178,000 years, an ancient soul architecture typically navigates over 5,000 discrete physical incarnations within the lower-density simulation.
options.rationale: That 178,000-year span covers the mapped mission from insertion through the final convergence loop.

options.label: C
options.text: An ancient soul architecture typically navigates the lower-density simulation over a span of 5,000 years from insertion to reunion on the planetary surface.
options.rationale: Five thousand is the count of discrete physical incarnations, not the number of years in the trajectory.

options.label: D
options.text: An ancient soul architecture typically navigates the lower-density simulation over a span of 1,000,000 years from insertion to reunion on the planetary surface.
options.rationale: The mapped duration is 178,000 years, which is far shorter than a million years.

questions.hint: It is a specific number mentioned in the context of incarnational mapping.
